einzeiler: Nikki Glaser announces the final episode of her podcast after a four-year run.
kurzfassung: Nikki Glaser opens the episode sharing a stressful day involving her dog going missing for hours before being found, followed by the news that the podcast is officially ending. The hosts reflect on the history of the show, express gratitude to their dedicated listeners, and even bring former co-host Andrew on the phone to say goodbye.
stichpunkte: Discussion about touring in Canada and performing in Portland, Maine
The harrowing story of the dog Goldie going missing for over thirteen hours
The relief and emotional whiplash of getting the dog back right before a comedy show
The major announcement that the podcast is ending after four years
Explanation that the closure is due to demanding schedules and a need to clear space for other projects
Praise for iHeart and the supportive community of listeners known as besties
A phone call with former co-host Andrew to reminisce about the early days of the show
Final farewells and expressions of gratitude to the production team and co-hosts

beschreibung:
Nikki really vibed with being in Canada this weekend and had a blast with her audience. Her shows in Hartford, CT, were emotional, finding out her dog Goldie went missing that morning. But don’t worry, it’s a happy ending! Sean and Emily, who were there for the whole thing, helped Nikki retell how she found out her pup was back in the middle of her performance. The Nikki Glaser Podcast also dropped a huge announcement that could take the Besties on an emotional ride, but Nikki did what she does best: showing her vulnerable side while adding her humor to a big life change. And Brian, Noa, Sean, and Emily are all super supportive and excited for her!
